title: Tape copying: Don’t Worry Kyoko (Mummy’s Only Looking For Her Hand In The Snow) by Plastic Ono Band | 1970
content:
A copy of the eight track tapes of ‘Don’t Worry Kyoko (Mummy’s Only Looking For Her Hand In The Snow)’, the b-side of the Plastic Ono Band’s second single ‘Cold Turkey’, was recorded on this day at EMI Studios, Abbey Road.

The song had been recorded on 3 October 1969, and released later that month. It is not known why a copy of the multitrack tape was made nine months later.
